{{Documentation}} [[Category:BITwiki Ontology]] ---- title: "INDEX" description: "This directory contains the '''expanded ontology specifications''' for BITwiki, extending the core knowledge graph with 6 additional entity types, 12 re" type: index author: "BITCORE" created: "2026-02-11" version: "1.0.0" ontology: entity_type: index-document domain: navigation epistemic_status: Attribution-Traced confidence: Emerging workflow: state: Beta license: CC-BY-SA-4.0 ---- = BITwiki Ontology Expansion = == Overview == This directory contains the '''expanded ontology specifications''' for BITwiki, extending the core knowledge graph with 12 composable entity types, 12 relationship patterns, and comprehensive epistemic frameworks. == Deliverables == === 1. Expanded Entity Types === '''File:''' `BITwiki_Expanded_Entity_Types.wiki` Extended specifications for 12 composable entity types: | Entity Type | Description | Page Type | |-------------|-------------|-----------| | '''Concept''' | Abstract ideas, categories, mental constructs | Topic | | '''Process''' | Dynamic sequences, workflows, transformations | Topic | | '''System''' | Organized collections of interacting components | Topic | | '''Entity''' | Distinct objects or beings | Topic | | '''Agent''' | Entities capable of action/decision | Agent | | '''Artifact''' | Created objects that carry knowledge | Dataset | | '''Relationship''' | Connections between entities | Topic | | '''Event''' | Temporal occurrences with significance | Topic | | '''State''' | Conditions at a point in time | Topic | | '''Data''' | Structured information | Dataset | | '''Knowledge''' | Justified true beliefs or validated information | Topic | | '''Model''' | Simplified representations of phenomena | Topic | === 2. Relationship Pattern Catalog === '''File:''' `BITwiki_Relationship_Pattern_Catalog.wiki` Twelve core relationship patterns with SMW implementation: | Pattern | Domain → Range | Cardinality | Transitive | |---------|----------------|-------------|------------| | '''Depends On''' | Any → Any | many-to-many | Yes | | '''Implements''' | Impl/Proc → Concept | many-to-many | No | | '''Uses''' | Agent/Proc → Tool/Res | many-to-many | No | | '''Creates''' | Agent → Artifact | one-to-many | No | | '''Influences''' | Any → Any | many-to-many | Yes | | '''Part Of''' | Any → Any | many-to-many | Yes | | '''Precedes''' | Event/Proc → Event/Proc | many-to-many | Yes | | '''References''' | Any → Resource | many-to-many | No | | '''Supports''' | Data → Knowledge | many-to-many | No | | '''Contradicts''' | Data/Claim → Claim | many-to-many | No | | '''Extends''' | Any → Any | many-to-many | Yes | | '''Governs''' | Agent/Org → Proc/Prot | many-to-many | No | === 3. Ontology Alignment Matrix === '''File:''' `BITwiki_Ontology_Alignment_Matrix.wiki` Cross-domain synthesis mapping to major ontologies: * '''Schema.org''' → Web standards alignment * '''FOAF''' → Agent and social relationships * '''Dublin Core''' → Metadata properties * '''SKOS''' → Concept and taxonomy mapping * '''Wikidata''' → Entity and property alignment * '''BIBO''' → Bibliographic resources * '''PROV-O''' → Provenance and attribution === 4. Epistemic Status Taxonomy === '''File:''' `BITwiki_Epistemic_Status_Taxonomy.wiki` Six epistemic descriptors replacing numeric confidence scores: | Status | Meaning | Use Case | |--------|---------|----------| | '''Established''' | Widely validated, consensus | Foundational knowledge | | '''Developing''' | Active validation ongoing | Emerging research | | '''Preliminary''' | Initial evidence, needs review | Early findings | | '''Speculative''' | Hypothesis, limited evidence | Theoretical work | | '''Disputed''' | Active controversy | Contested claims | | '''Deprecated''' | Superseded or obsolete | Historical reference | Includes status transition workflows and claim-level epistemic tracking. === 5. Visual Diagram Specification === '''File:''' `BITwiki_Visual_Diagram_Specification.wiki` Six diagram types in Mermaid and DOT formats: # '''Entity Type Hierarchy''' - 12-type taxonomy # '''Core Relationship Patterns''' - 12-pattern network graph # '''Epistemic Status Flow''' - State machine transitions # '''Domain Alignment Network''' - Cross-domain mappings # '''Query Pattern Visualization''' - NL to SMW pipeline # '''EPV Framework''' - Event-Process-Value model All diagrams use valid Mermaid syntax with: * Underscores for entity names (MY_ENTITY) * Quoted multi-word labels ("depends on") * Proper cardinality notation == SMW Compatibility == All specifications align with existing BITwiki SMW infrastructure: * ✅ Property types: Page, Text, Number, Date, URL, Boolean * ✅ Category syntax: `[[Category:...]]` * ✅ Property declarations: `[[Has type::...]]` * ✅ Query syntax: `{{#ask:...}}` * ✅ Subobjects: `{{#subobject:...}}` * ✅ Inverse properties: `[[Has inverse property::...]]` == Integration Points == === With Existing Ontology === * Extends `BITwiki_Entity_Types.wiki` (12 composable types) * Enhances `BITwiki_Relationship_Types.wiki` (12 patterns) * Compatible with `BITwiki_Property_Types.wiki` (70+ properties) * Aligns with `BITwiki_Taxonomy_Architecture.wiki` (category hierarchy) === With Research Synthesis === * Maps to knowledge representation research * Maps to ontology engineering research * Maps to semantic web research * Maps to epistemology research == Usage == === Creating New Entity Instances === ```mediawiki {{Entity |Type=Concept |Name=Knowledge Graph |Has definition=A network of entities and relationships |Has domain=Knowledge Representation |Has epistemic status=Established }} ``` === Querying by Epistemic Status === ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has epistemic status::Established]] [[Has domain::Ontology]] |?Has definition |format=table }} ``` === Visualizing Relationships === 
graph TD
    A[Agent] -->|"Creates"| C[Construct]
    C -->|"Depends On"| I[Invariant]
    I -->|"Used In"| P[Protocol]
== File Statistics == | File | Lines | Size | Description | |------|-------|------|-------------| | BITwiki_Expanded_Entity_Types.wiki | 450+ | 14KB | Entity definitions | | BITwiki_Relationship_Pattern_Catalog.wiki | 350+ | 11KB | Relationship patterns | | BITwiki_Ontology_Alignment_Matrix.wiki | 280+ | 9KB | Domain mappings | | BITwiki_Epistemic_Status_Taxonomy.wiki | 330+ | 10KB | Status framework | | BITwiki_Visual_Diagram_Specification.wiki | 260+ | 8KB | Visual diagrams | | '''Total''' | '''1,670+''' | '''52KB''' | '''Complete expansion''' | == Version Information == * '''Version''': 2.0.0 * '''Date''': 2026-02-10 * '''Author''': Agent:Hyperion (BITCORE Research Swarm) * '''Status''': Revised per HUMAN_REVIEW.md directives * '''Compatibility''': BITwiki Ontology 2.0.0+ == Key Changes in Version 2.0.0 == === Removed === * ❌ Blockchain-specific entity types * ❌ Numeric confidence scores (0.0-1.0) * ❌ Domain-specific overfitting * ❌ Invalid mermaid syntax === Added === * ✅ 12 composable entity types * ✅ 6 epistemic descriptors * ✅ EPV framework implementation * ✅ Valid mermaid diagrams * ✅ Domain-neutral examples * ✅ Research citations === Changed === * 🔄 Rigid entity lists → Composable types * 🔄 Numeric scores → Qualitative descriptors * 🔄 Blockchain examples → Domain-neutral examples * 🔄 Noun properties → Verb-phrase properties == See Also == * [[BITwiki:Ontology_Index]] - Complete ontology reference * [[BITwiki:Entity_Types]] - Core entity specifications * [[BITwiki:Relationship_Types]] - Relationship taxonomy * [[BITwiki:Property_Types]] - Property definitions * [[BITwiki:Semantic_Patterns]] - Design patterns * [[BITwiki:Taxonomy_Architecture]] - Category hierarchy == References == * Wolfram Entity-Property-Value Model * Semantic MediaWiki Documentation * BITCORE Foundation Ontology Standards * FAIR Data Principles * SKOS Simple Knowledge Organization System
